W3C liability, trademark and permissive document license rules apply", where 'permissive document license' links to https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2015/copyright-software-and-document (the W3C Software and Document License, SPDX W3C-20150513). That licence permits copying, modifying and distributing the work provided the notice, any pre-existing notices, and a statement of changes go with every copy; the notice is in `note`, so this entry holds the text in full (issue #1614).
note: Source: the W3C Working Group's own publication snapshot of the Recommendation, github.com/w3c/json-ld-syntax at commit 029777cff904bfa59cfdfc19e2c6c6098e33ef60, path publication-snapshots/REC/Overview.html (last changed there in a97d1d26648fea976298026a90e571f20ba889b7, 2020-07-07). Its status section and header read 'W3C Recommendation 16 July 2020', 'This version: https://www.w3.org/TR/2020/REC-json-ld11-20200716/'. It is therefore the REC text as the WG staged it for publication, NOT an editor's draft; w3.org is unreachable from the ingesting container, so it was not compared byte for byte with the copy at https://www.w3.org/TR/2020/REC-json-ld11-20200716/. Printed to PDF offline (headless Chromium 141, network blocked, document outline from the headings), then ingested with the pdf-structure rung. Styles and the W3C logo, which load from w3.org, are absent from the print; the text and the repository-local figures are not. Errata published after the REC are not included.
